details.claim: The crater was discovered in the late 1970s by geophysicists Glen Penfield and Antonio Camargo.
The crater was named after the nearby town of Chicxulub Pueblo.
The impact occurred around 66 million years ago, coinciding with the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.
